description: deals blackjack a move at a time: the table as text for the chat, and as a picture for Canvas.

bet.description: chips to bet on a deal; the last bet when left out, 10 at a new table

chips.description: chips to sit down with at a new table; 100 when left out

move.description: deal, hit, stand, double, show, or new; left out, deal when no hand is in play, else show

seed.description: a number that fixes the shuffle, so a game plays again card for card; a fresh shuffle when left out

table.description: where the table's picture is kept, in the folder; blackjack/table.png when left out

title: What blackjack takes
